title: Write the owner guide with copy-paste steps and expected output
goal: docs/acceptance/f157-cloud-turn-on-<date>.md with exact commands and the expected result of each
acceptance: Steps: (1) console.anthropic.com, create an account separate from claude.ai, add billing and a small prepaid amount, create an API key named nerv; (2) `nerv models key` and paste it; (3) `nerv models cloud allow|deny` per F-156-T04; (4) `nerv models set misato cloud sonnet` (or haiku); limit 5; (5) ask three questions, `nerv models` shows spend and the estimate
Each step lists what the output must show and how to turn it off again (`nerv models cloud off`)
No key, name or personal data in Git
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no keys, tokens, personal data or real Grover readings in Git.
escalation: Any run of a real model or a cloud call needs the owner's yes first
A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-27 from the code paths read for this plan. Not a measurement.
